title: Focus-wheel interface authoring through Wright
summary: Normal Wright workspace and actual isolated engineering run. No mocked routes or physical action.

manualSteps.label: Open workspace
manualSteps.instruction: Open the isolated Repeated focus-wheel preparation proof workspace.

manualSteps.label: Open workflows
manualSteps.instruction: Click Workflows in the workspace activity bar.

manualSteps.label: Choose process
manualSteps.instruction: Click Workflow files, then Open workflow. Select the saved focus-wheel workflow.

manualSteps.label: Use process
manualSteps.instruction: Click Use saved process. Reopen the recorded run from its workspace link.

manualSteps.label: Create an interface
manualSteps.instruction: Click Create or choose interface. Enter Focus-wheel original-input preparation as the Interface title and request a reusable comparison with shared inputs, results, findings and review controls. Click Create interface.

manualSteps.label: Preview
manualSteps.instruction: Wait for Preview ready, then click Open preview and inspect the read-only interface.

manualSteps.label: Save
manualSteps.instruction: Return to the common working tab and click Save interface.

manualSteps.label: Open saved interface
manualSteps.instruction: Click Open saved interface. Confirm it opens in a Wright workspace tab on the existing run.

steps.label: Visible interface creation
steps.summary: Wright is creating the tailored interface using its actual configured default model.
steps.action: Enter Interface title: Focus-wheel original-input preparation. Request: Adapt the supplied reference into a Focus-wheel original-input preparation. Reuse its public components, callbacks, all inputs/readiness, progress, pending interactions, ResultRepresentation viewers and exact evidence/assessment/block navigation. Change the heading and arrange all current geometry, package and assessment result cards in a responsive evidence grid. Keep all contract data and manifest identities; work across runs without fixed output filenames or run IDs. Keep source concise by reusing the reference, without new controls, custom viewers, execution, verdicts or protocols. Return only the required source/manifest JSON.. Click Create interface.
controls: How should this interface help the user?

steps.actual: Actual interface job accepted; creation progress visible.
